alternates.summary: Bloomberg’s Ed Ludlow breaks down the latest jobs data, as US employers unexpectedly cut jobs in July and questions grow over AI’s role in the labor market. Plus, the CEOs of Twilio, Lyft, and DraftKings join to discuss their latest earnings. And, OpenAI’s first consumer device is taking shape, an AI smart speaker designed to look like a doughnut. (Source: Bloomberg)
alternates.title: Jobs, AI, and Tech Earnings | Bloomberg Tech 8/07/2026

alternates.summary: Gen Digital's shares are reaching their highest levels in nearly a year following an upward revision of its earnings forecast. Vincent Pilette, President and CEO of Gen Digital, expressed strong confidence in sustaining double-digit growth over the coming quarters, driven by increased demand for cybersecurity solutions amid growing concerns related to AI and agentic technologies. He speaks with Romaine Bostick on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)
alternates.title: Gen CEO on Earnings, New Cybersecurity Attack Tracker

articles.summary: OpenAI said this model, which is still in development, reached its "critical cybersecurity threshold," meaning it could independently identify and carry out cyberattacks against traditionally well-protected real-world systems.
articles.title: OpenAI says it slowed Astra model development over security concerns

articles.summary: Historian Jill Lepore has a theory about why tech companies often use soaring language to describe their products — almost as if they’re forming a new government. articles.title: Jill Lepore on the ‘Artificial State’ and why Silicon Valley’s leaders are bad sci-fi readers

articles.summary: OpenAI says it is pausing "internal activities" around an in-development AI model, Astra, because it doesn't yet meet new security standards the company is putting in place. The announcement follows its recent disclosure that OpenAI models accidentally hacked Hugging Face. Anthropic and Meta have also since admitted that they had AI models that went rogue […]
articles.title: OpenAI puts the brakes on a new model because it’s supposedly too powerful

articles.summary: Kitesurf is a cloud-hosted browser designed for AI agents instead of people. It uses less computing power than Chromium for common automation tasks, helping developers build browser-based AI agents more efficiently.
articles.title: Cloudflare launches Kitesurf, a browser built for AI agents

articles.summary: After its own AI usage wake-up call, Rippling this week unveiled AI Spend Console, a product that tracks individual and team employee AI spending.
articles.title: After Rippling blew millions on AI in months, it built an employee ROI tool

articles.summary: Airbnb will debut a new AI-powered search experience with a toggle.
articles.title: Airbnb says AI is helping it ship features faster as it tests a new search function

articles.summary: OpenAI is pausing some internal work around one of its upcoming artificial intelligence models to implement stricter safeguards after the system was found to be significantly more adept at cybersecurity tasks.
articles.title: OpenAI Pauses Some Work on New Astra Model on Cyber Concerns
